verdicts.title: On bounded depth proofs for Tseitin formulas on the grid; revisited
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We study Frege proofs using depth-$d$ Boolean formulas for the Tseitin contradiction on $n \times n$ grids. verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract addresses size-vs-line-count lower bounds for bounded-depth Frege proofs of Tseitin on grids ('if each line is of size M then the number of lines is exponential in n/(log M)^O(d)'), which does not speak to the monotonicity of Φ(π)/proof_size in DP/resolution proofs.
